what_happened.line: The town manager presented her FY19 budget recommendation, balanced without using free cash for operating expenses.
The recommendation covers revenues, state aid, the operating increase, capital requests and borrowing for a ladder truck, with the school increase set as recommended.
The Governor's proposal gives a small increase in Chapter 70 and unrestricted aid, with 40S funding much lower.
Committee members and residents asked about snow and ice, capital items, school funding and retiree health liability; no budget vote was taken and the only vote was adjournment.
Next week's meetings are set for Council on Aging, library and land use, then fire and police; no Tuesday meeting for the audit presentation.

why_it_matters: Free cash is kept out of operating costs and goes to one-time uses, which bears on whether the FY19 tax levy rests on money that recurs.
The school increase, the ladder truck borrowing and the unfunded retiree health liability all shape future tax bills and what Town Meeting will be asked to approve.
